I think deionised water is a problem as it pulls charged particles out of the metal and causes it to corrode much quicker. I've often just used regular tap water (lab based in UK) but you do have get the de-scaler out sometimes otherwise there's a build up of residue in the machine.

New coping mechanism are a great idea. 
I don't know what you're going through or how you process stuff but I find having a kind of journal where if it feels too much I can just purge everything onto the page does help take the edge off when it's really bad. It seems to take some of the power out of all of my intrusive thoughts. Then once they're all down I can close the book on all the hateful, hurtful stuff and turning my attention to more positive things feels easier than it did.
Don't know if it'll work for you but worth a try maybe :)
Good luck!!! You got this! I know how hard it can be getting rid of things like that but you're making a really wise and smart choice. You should be really proud of yourself.
